title: Agency Email Template Pack

decisions.decision: Targeted agency/services revenue moments instead of a generic visual template pack.
Kept templates text-first with no remote images, scripts, or external stylesheets to protect deliverability.
Enforced {{tag|fallback}} syntax across every dynamic value so personalization never ships blank.

unresolved: Owner approval for pricing ($29 / $79 / $149) and public store publication.
Buyer must run a seed test in the target ESP before the first live send.
evidence: Reference campaign passed the email-marketing campaign validator.
Distribution ZIP built with product-manifest.json hashes.
